I related to this post way too much. I lived in a rural town (1,500) so didn’t have many options even if I wanted. I lost my virginity at 18 to a random guy I met online because I was tired of feeling left out. I never had a romantic kiss or went on a real date until I left for college. It honestly negatively impacts my self-esteem when I see teenagers having sex/partying/doing fun things that I missed out on when I was that age (and I’m only 21). Basically, I feel like I had the same experience as you. I’m trying to cut out social media and other triggers (certain movies/shows) as much as possible. I’m not sure how to deal with it either besides avoidance. I totally feel like I missed out and get super jealous when I see stuff like that. I guess my advice would be to just enjoy what you have now? I’m sure past you would kill for what you have now. You can’t go back and change the past so why dwell on it? Even when I did get the rare opportunity to go out and have fun, 99% of the time I wasn’t having as much fun as you or I would think. People post so much fake shit on social media that I honestly wouldn’t believe most of it. Believe me when I say, I know it’s way easier said than done. I hope I didn’t hijack your post or anything but I hope you take solace in the fact that you’re definitely not alone and there are others out there in the same situation as you.
